title: Dekisugi-kun — Make understanding explainable
capture: Current native Android app on a dedicated emulator. Edited for pace; no fabricated UI or seeded progress.

scenes.title:
You learn.
By teaching him.
scenes.body:
Middle and high-school science.
Explain why, not just which answer.
scenes.tag: A companion that needs your explanation
narration: Recognizing an answer is different from explaining why it works.
Dekisugi-kun turns science study into teaching a companion.

scenes.title:
A real question.
Your own prediction.
scenes.body:
Two balls. Same height.
Which falls first in a vacuum?
scenes.tag: Start with a belief you can revisit
narration: For middle and high-school learners, each mission starts with a concrete question.
I predict that the heavier ball falls faster.

scenes.title:
Look for why.
Look for when.
scenes.body:
A focused lesson explains
the principle and its conditions.
narration: The lesson explains why both balls fall together, and when that claim holds.

scenes.title:
Close the material.
Teach it back.
scenes.body:
The source disappears.
Text is a full route alongside voice.
narration: Then the material disappears. I must explain it in my own words.
Typing is a full learning route, alongside voice.

scenes.title:
A new case
tests my explanation.
scenes.body:
Key terms are a prompt to reflect.
A fixed question checks a new case.
scenes.tag: Coverage is not a mastery score
narration: Key-term coverage prompts reflection, not a mastery score.
A fixed follow-up asks me to apply the idea to a new case.

scenes.title:
A hint.
Then another explanation.
scenes.body:
A wrong choice points me back
to the missing condition.
narration: My wrong choice brings a hint about the vacuum condition.
I rethink my explanation instead of receiving an answer to copy.

scenes.title:
Keep track of
what needs another look.
scenes.body:
The companion’s record keeps
uncertain ideas available for review.
scenes.tag: Observed uncertainty, not a weakness label
narration: The companion's record keeps uncertain ideas for a matching repair activity.
Rewriting alone does not mark an idea corrected.

scenes.title:
Learning stays
on the device.
scenes.body:
No account for core learning.
No upload or AI grading of free text.
narration: The core works offline, without an account.
Student explanations are neither uploaded nor graded by an external AI.

scenes.title:
Support the app.
Keep learning free.
scenes.body:
Optional companion styling
and parent reports.
scenes.tag: RevenueCat Test Store · No real charge
narration: RevenueCat powers optional Plus, with companion styling and parent reports.
Here is a completed Test Store purchase. No real charge, and core lessons stay free.

scenes.title:
Read it.
Explain it.
Rethink it.
scenes.body:
Native Flutter. 12 science units.
35 concepts. MIT source.
narration: Dekisugi-kun. Make explaining part of studying.
